subject: Animation
title: The Simpsons' Voice Cast Secrets
description: Learn The Simpsons' Voice Cast Secrets in one minute.

hook.text: Six voice actors perform nearly every major character in The Simpsons — often several characters each.

buildup.text: Dan Castellaneta voices Homer, Grampa, Krusty, and dozens more. Each voice is a distinct creation.

discovery.text: Hank Azaria once voiced over 30 recurring characters, switching between them in a single recording session.

twist.text: In recent years, the show stopped having white actors voice non-white characters like Apu and Dr. Hibbert.

climax.text: The voice cast's versatility was key to building Springfield's enormous world on a TV budget.

punchline.text: Six actors gave voices to an entire town of hundreds.

quiz.question: How did The Simpsons build such a large world of characters?
options: They hired hundreds of voice actors over the years
Six core voice actors each performed dozens of distinct characters
They used computer-generated voices from the beginning
